description.zh: 是否返回所有数据(不分页)。
description.en: Specifies whether to return all results without pagination.

description.zh:
过滤流量调控目标。

- All：返回所有。

- Valid：返回有效的（开始结束时间段内是开启状态的）。

- None：不返回。
description.en:
The filter for traffic control targets. Valid values:

- `All`: Returns all traffic control targets.

- `Valid`: Returns only active traffic control targets. A traffic control target is active if the current time is within the specified start and end time.

- `None`: Does not return any traffic control targets.

description.zh:
运行环境。

- Daily-日常环境。

- Pre-预发环境。

- Prod-生产环境。
description.en:
The environment. Valid values:

- `Daily`: the daily environment

- `Pre`: the pre-production environment

- `Prod`: the production environment
The instance ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListInstances](https://icms.alibaba-inc.com/content/learn/pai?l=1\&m=16768\&n=4300782) operation.
The name of the traffic control task.

description.zh:
排序方式，取值：

- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `ASC`: ascending order

- `DESC`: descending order
The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
The ID of the scene. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListScenes](~~2402581~~) operation.

description.zh:
排序依据。
- GmtCreateTime：按创建时间排序。
- GmtModifiedTime-按更新时间排序。
description.en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- `GmtCreateTime`: Sorts the results by creation time.

- `GmtModifiedTime`: Sorts the results by modification time.

description.zh:
状态。

- NotRunning：未运行。

- Ready：待运行。

- Running：运行中。

- Finished：已结束。
description.en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

- `NotRunning`: The task is not running.

- `Ready`: The task is ready to run.

- `Running`: The task is running.

- `Finished`: The task is finished.
The ID of the traffic control task.

description.zh:
版本。

- Latest：最新版本，默认值

- Released：已发布版本
description.en:
The version. Valid values:

- `Latest`: The latest version. This is the default value.

- `Released`: the released version

title.zh: 获取流量调控任务列表
title.en: Retrieve the traffic control job list

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 该API用于获取符合特定条件的流量调控任务列表。
- 用户可以通过提供不同的查询参数来过滤和排序返回的任务列表。
- 支持分页查询，也可以选择一次性返回所有数据（不分页）。
- 注意：`InstanceId` 是必填项，其他参数均为可选项，根据实际需求填写以获得更精确的结果。
descriptions.en:
## Request

- This API retrieves a list of traffic control tasks.

- Use query parameters to filter and sort the results.

- This operation supports pagination. You can also retrieve all results in a single response.

- Note: The `InstanceId` is a required parameter. All other parameters are optional.
